diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.brique-bourgogne research.needed (no substance record yet)
diffuseAlbedo.note: A first iron-oxide red for a Burgundy hand-moulded brick, read from trade photographs.

refractiveIndex.note: Fired clay is quartz, feldspar and glass, indices 1.5 to 1.6; the middle is taken.

porosity.source: Briqueterie Dewulf, Fiche Technique B212436, https://briqueterie-dewulf.fr/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Fiche-Technique-B212436-STD.pdf: solid brick ('Brique pleine') 22 x 10,5 x 5,5, tolerance L,l,h +/-3 %, 2,47 kg, Hoffmann-kiln fired, 'Brique compatible restauration monuments historiques'; Handbook of Mineralogy, 'Quartz': D(meas.) = 2.65
porosity.note: This is total (open plus closed) porosity from nominal dimensions. The +/-3 % dimensional tolerance alone moves it by about +/-0.06, and a skeletal density of 2.6 to 2.7 gives 0.25 to 0.28. It is a northern French restoration brick, not a Burgundy one, and the fiche does not state where it was made. It supports the old 0.25 but is not a measurement of this brick.

wettingDepth.note: As the lime plaster: the depth whose pores govern the face's look.

grain.note: The sand in a moulded brick's face.

bed.source: French Wikipedia 'Brique' typology (mirror https://fr-academic.com/dic.nsf/frwiki/241394): 'Brique de Bourgogne : 22 x 11 x 6 (c'est un arrondi dans le système métrique de 8 x 4 x 2 pouces)'
bed.note: The value is unchanged, now with a source for the format. The Eau de Paris Montmartre brochure mentioned in the proposal was not opened by me, so leave it out of the evidence.
bed.derivation: The Burgundy brick's length is 22 cm = 220 mm

bedAspect.source: A moulded body has no bedding

toneSpread.note: Hand-moulded bricks vary brick to brick with their firing.
